caption: The drawing depicts a tall, wooden grandfather clock centered on a plain, beige background. The clock is composed of three main sections: the top housing a square clock face, the central section with a door and a small handle, and the base which is rectangular and slightly tapered at the feet. The wooden structure has a warm, brown color with visible grain patterns. The clock face is pale with black Roman numerals and two black clock hands, as well as additional decorative black elements. The upper section above the clock face is arched. There is text on the clock face reading “Benjamin Minch, Quaker Street, 1790.” The artist's signature, “Irving L. Smith,” is visible in the bottom right corner of the beige background. The drawing is rendered with subtle shading around the edges of the clock to suggest depth, while the background remains flat and unadorned.
title: Shaker Tall Clock
